title: Hawk-Eyed Halberd of the Two Tracks
summary: A school manual that teaches the halberd by sighting along two tracks at once and closes with the school's two-track verdict.

title: The Azure Basin Axe Doctrine
summary: A school doctrine that fills the whole basin of a fight with the axe and ends in the basin doctrine stroke.

title: River-Bound Halberd Classic
summary: A school classic that binds the halberd to the course of a river from bank to flood and ends in one flowing stroke.

title: Tracks Crossing: A Halberd Doctrine
summary: A school doctrine on the point where two tracks of attack cross and the fall of the axe that ends the exchange.

title: Hawk Above the Basin: The High Halberd
summary: A school manual of the high halberd that watches the basin from above and descends on a single chosen mark.

title: Azure Core Halberd Canon of Two Rivers
summary: A school canon for formed Cores that runs two rivers of qi through the halberd and joins them in one stroke.

title: Wind-Sworn Halberd of the Plateau
summary: A school manual that swears the halberd to the plateau wind and ends in the school's wind-sworn stroke.

title: The Oath Axe Bearings
summary: A school text on taking a bearing and keeping the axe on it until the oath axe stroke lands.

title: Rites of the Long Gale Halberd
summary: A school set of rites for the halberd that follow the long gale across the plateau and end in a falling stroke.

title: Halberd Where the Plateau Ends
summary: A school manual of fighting at the last edge of the plateau where the ground itself becomes a weapon.

title: The Oath Held Against the Wind
summary: A school manual on holding a sworn line against the strongest wind and cutting only along that line.

title: Core Halberd of the Sworn Gale
summary: A school canon for formed Cores that turns the sworn gale into the halberd's reach and edge.

title: Signature Halberd Doctrine
summary: A school doctrine that teaches the halberd as a tool for taking a road end to end and closes in the stroke that claims its whole width.
